artworks.title: Portrait of a Fortune Teller
artworks.description: The image features a woman shown from head to knee, crouched with her left hand resting on her knee and right hand holding cards. She has curly hair that falls to her shoulders and wears earrings, a necklace, and a headpiece. Her facial features include large eyes and a direct gaze. She is dressed in an outfit with a blouse, embellished sleeves, and a skirt with netting overlay. Her left wrist has a bracelet, and she wears shoes with buckles. The background appears blurred, with vegetation or textured backdrop. A card is visible on the ground by her right foot.

artworks.title: "Pearl Keller, 18 Months Old, and Ada Sylvester"
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman cutting fabric at a table while a young girl sits on a cushion on the floor beside her. The woman has her hair styled in a bun and wears a dark long-sleeved dress with an apron. The young girl wears a dress with striped sleeves under a frilly apron and has curly hair. Various pieces of fabric are scattered on the floor around them. The background consists of a plain, neutral wall and a patterned carpet underfoot.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman Peeling Apples
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly woman seated, with her entire body visible. She is sitting in a frontal position, facing the camera with her hands resting in a basin on her lap. Her facial features are wrinkled, and she has a calm, neutral expression. Her hair is hidden under a headdress adorned with flowers. The woman is wearing a long, dark patterned dress with light floral designs and a white apron over it. A white lace collar sits around her neck with a floral decoration at her chest. She is holding a vegetable in one hand. Beside her on the floor is a metal tub and a few vegetables. To her side, a small wooden round table has food canisters and a towel draped over the edge. The background is a simple, textured wall.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Wellesley College Graduate, Class of 1897
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman pouring liquid from a spoon into a glass. She is standing in a studio setting, wearing a traditional nurse's uniform and standing next to a small table with bottles and glassware. A chair with wicker detail is seen behind her.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Weaving Mill Woman
artworks.description: The image depicts a young woman standing in a factory setting. She is positioned facing slightly toward the viewer, with her left arm outstretched near machinery. Her hair is short and styled away from her face. She wears a light-colored blouse with short sleeves and a dark ribbon tied at her neck. The background shows rows of machines with threads and spindles in an industrial building.

artworks.title: Portrait of Child Maids
artworks.description: Two young girls are depicted in a full-body view standing on a plain floor. The girl on the left is slightly shorter, standing with her body turned slightly to the right and facing the camera. She has dark eyebrows and curls in her shoulder-length hair, wearing a checkered dress with puffed sleeves and holding a mop. The girl on the right is taller, holding a broom with both hands, looking down. She has long, smooth, dark hair, wearing a striped dress, black stockings, and shoes. There are cleaning items around them: a wooden bucket, a mop, and a bowl on the floor, with a partially visible chair in the top left. The background is a simple, textured wall.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Knife Sharpener
artworks.description: The image displays a young boy positioned behind a mechanical device. The boy is standing with his body slightly turned to the right, hands resting on the wooden apparatus. He has short hair mostly covered by a brimmed hat, with a youthful complexion and is wearing a buttoned-up shirt and dark trousers. The mechanical device includes a hand-operated wheel with a belt attached. The background consists of a tiled floor with a checkered pattern and a plain wall, indicating a studio or workshop setting.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Wicker Chair Maker
artworks.description: The image shows a young man sitting on a wooden chair, with his full body visible. He is seated in an upright position, with his hands placed on his lap while holding a partially constructed basket made from thin wooden rods. His facial features include a high forehead, thick eyebrows, and a neutral expression. His hair is neatly combed and parted to the side. He is wearing a dark pinstriped vest over a light-colored long-sleeved shirt, and his vest has a watch chain attached to a button. He is dressed in dark pants and shoes. The floor is covered with a patterned carpet consisting of hexagonal designs. The background is plain and textured, suggesting an indoor setting.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Candy Seller
artworks.description: The image depicts a young boy seated on a rock. He is facing sideways with his head slightly turned towards the viewer. He has a round face, light-colored eyes, and a subtle blush on his cheeks. He is wearing a striped cap, dark double-breasted jacket, knee-length pants, dark socks, and buttoned boots. He is holding a box labeled "CANDY" in one hand, with the other hand resting on his leg. The background shows a painted landscape with trees, possibly at sunset.

artworks.title: Portrait of Tin Smith and Apprentice
artworks.description: The image shows two men seated side by side in wooden chairs. The man on the left holds a large metal jug in his left hand, while the man on the right holds a spouted pitcher in his left hand. The man on the left has short, dark hair with a side part and a serious expression. He is wearing a vertical striped shirt, a button-up vest, and trousers. The man on the right has short, lighter hair and is also wearing a striped shirt with a vest and trousers. Both men are wearing vests with several buttons. The background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: Portrait of Shoeshine Boys
artworks.description: The image shows two boys standing side by side. The boy on the left has short hair and a neutral expression, wearing a checked shirt and pants with suspenders. The boy on the right has wavier hair, looking downward, wearing a shirt with a bow around his neck. They are both barefoot on a patterned surface. Between them is a block-like object with a shoe on top. The backdrop is a painted scenic view of a lake, mountains, and greenery.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Field Picker
artworks.description: The image depicts a young boy seated on a bench. He is sitting with his legs slightly apart and his right arm resting on a large, woven basket next to him. His facial expression is neutral, with slightly wide eyes, and he has short, dark hair. He wears a large straw hat that shades his face and holds a small block or box in his left hand. The boy is dressed in overalls over a long-sleeved shirt with rolled-up sleeves, and he has a loosely tied scarf around his neck. The background features a rustic, painted setting that resembles trees or foliage. To the right of the boy, there are a couple of boxes stacked on the bench.

artworks.title: Portrait of Breaker Boys
artworks.description: The image depicts two young boys kneeling on a patterned rug on a wooden floor. Both boys are shown from the knees up. The boy on the left wears a dark, fur-like hat and jacket, while the boy on the right wears a flat cap and a dark jacket with a visible shirt underneath. Each boy holds large chunks of rock or ore and a small hammer. Their facial features are somewhat indistinct due to the age and quality of the photo, but both appear youthful, with the boy on the left being slightly blurred. The backdrop shows a scene with a large fountain and foliage, resembling an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Newspaper Boy
artworks.description: The image depicts a young boy standing upright. He has a serious expression with short, neatly combed hair. He is dressed in layers: a checked overcoat over a buttoned vest and collared shirt. He is holding a bundle of newspapers in his right hand and resting his left hand on a chair next to a table covered with dark, patterned fabric. He wears laced boots and a chain on his vest. The background is a plain wall with a heavy curtain on the left side.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Telegrapher Boy
artworks.description: This sepia-toned photograph shows a young boy seated at a wooden table. He has pale skin, short, light-colored hair, and wears a textured jacket over a light-colored shirt and a tie. He is focused on an object in front of him, which appears to be a piece of telegraph equipment on the round table. Next to it is a sheet of paper. The background is plain with some visible scratches and marks, suggesting wear.

artworks.title: Portrait of Coal Delivery Boys
artworks.description: The image shows two young boys in an old-fashioned photograph. Both boys stand full-length and side by side. The boy on the left has his hands in his pockets, while the boy on the right holds a metal bucket. Both boys have short hair and wear dark caps, coats, trousers, and knee-high boots. The boy on the right wears gloves. The background features intricate woodwork, possibly in a room with Victorian-style décor. The floor is wooden planks, and the image is in grayscale.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Tinsmith
artworks.description: The image shows a young man kneeling on the floor. He is holding a bucket in one hand and a soldering tool over a flame with the other. He has a serious expression on his face, looking directly at the camera. He has short dark hair under a bowler hat and wears a dark suit with a buttoned-up vest, a shirt, and striped trousers. He is surrounded by soldering tools and a soldering device. The background is a plain, neutral-toned backdrop.

artworks.title: Portrait of Children Sawing Wood
artworks.description: The image depicts two young boys standing near a wooden sawhorse. The boy on the left is upright, holding a stick or tool, wearing a cap, dark coat, and trousers. The boy on the right is bent over the sawhorse, with his hands on it, wearing a striped jacket and pants. The background includes decorative elements like a large urn and framed images on a patterned wall.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Shoeshine Boy
artworks.description: The image depicts a young individual seated, capturing their full body in the portrait. They are sitting on a small wooden block with one leg crossed over the other. The person has short, curly hair and distinct facial features, looking directly at the camera with a neutral expression. They are wearing a light-colored shirt with a bow tie and knee-length plaid shorts, paired with knee-high socks and lace-up boots. In their lap, they hold a shoe and a brush, suggesting they might be polishing it. On the floor in front of them, there is a small can, a second brush, and another item related to shoe care. The background features a painted backdrop with foliage and greenery, providing a vintage studio setting.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Carpenter Helper
artworks.description: This image depicts a young boy standing in a room. He has a serious expression, a round face, large eyes, short hair under a flat cap, a patterned shirt with a visible collar, overalls, a bow tie, and short boots. He holds a wooden mallet by his waist. The room has decorative woodwork and patterned wallpaper, with wooden planks leaning on a table and a wooden basket nearby. Elaborate carvings adorn the walls.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Newspaper Boy
artworks.description: The image depicts a young boy standing upright, facing slightly to the left. He has short, neatly combed hair and a neutral expression. The boy is wearing a checkered jacket and pants, a shirt, and a loosely tied bow tie. He holds a stack of newspapers under one arm with a strap over his shoulder. The background is a plain, textured backdrop. At the bottom, there is a signature, "W.C. Bell", and an address, "No. 6 West Market St., York, Pa."

artworks.title: Portrait of a Saturday Evening Post Paperboy
artworks.description: The image depicts a boy standing and facing the camera. He has cropped dark hair and a neutral expression. The boy wears a dark suit with a double-breasted coat and shorts, a white shirt, a dark tie, knee-high socks, polished shoes, and a flat cap. He carries a large canvas bag with "The Saturday Evening Post" printed on it and holds a copy of the publication in his left hand. The background is a plain, light-colored backdrop.

artworks.title: Albert Barnes, "Picking Slate"
artworks.description: This is a photograph of individuals engaged in the task of sorting pieces of slate from piles of rock in an industrial setting. The individuals are wearing laborious work clothes, and the photograph is in sepia tone.
